# Backend Domain Core Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build the fully tested domain model and use cases of the investments backend — every business rule that today lives in browser JavaScript — with zero infrastructure dependencies.

**Architecture:** Clean architecture generated by the Bancolombia scaffold. `domain/model` holds value objects, entities and ports (interfaces) and compiles against nothing but the JDK. `domain/usecase` holds business logic and depends only on `domain/model`. No Spring, no JPA, no HTTP in this plan. Every use case is tested with JUnit 5 and Mockito against mocked ports.

**Tech Stack:** Java 25, Gradle 9.7.1 (wrapper), Spring Boot 4.1.1 (declared but unused in this plan), JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ, JaCoCo 0.8.15.

**Spec:** `spec.md` (sections 3, 4.1–4.5; phases 1–4 of section 8)

## Global Constraints

- Java version: **25**. Toolchain pinned via `JavaLanguageVersion.of(25)`.
- Root package: **`co.com.david.inversiones`**.
- `domain/model` and `domain/usecase` must have **zero framework dependencies**. No Spring, no Lombok, no JPA annotations. Verified by `./gradlew validateStructure`.
- **Builder pattern** is mandatory for any type with more than three construction parameters. Builders in `domain` are hand-written (no Lombok, which is a framework dependency there). Value objects with three or fewer parameters use static factory methods (`Money.of`, `Ticker.of`).
- All monetary amounts use `BigDecimal` normalized to **scale 10, `RoundingMode.HALF_UP`**. Never `double` or `float`.
- Value objects are **immutable**. Prefer `record`.
- Dependency injection by **constructor only**. Use cases receive ports, never implementations.
- Time is injected through the `TimeProvider` port. **No test may call `LocalDate.now()` or `Instant.now()`.**
- Javadoc in **English** on every public type and every non-obvious public method.
- Commits follow **Conventional Commits in English**, signed off with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Test assertions use **AssertJ** (`assertThat`), not raw JUnit assertions.
- Run every Gradle command from `backend/` using `./gradlew`, never the system `gradle` (8.13 cannot run on Java 25).

## Domain Type Reference

Every task below builds part of this. Signatures here are authoritative — later tasks depend on them exactly as written.

```
model/
  Currency                enum { USD, COP }
  Money                   record (BigDecimal amount, Currency currency)
  Ticker                  record (String symbol)
  Quantity                record (BigDecimal value)
  Percentage              record (BigDecimal value)
  ExchangeRate            record (Currency base, Currency quote, BigDecimal rate, LocalDate rateDate)
  InstrumentType          enum { EQUITY, ETF, ADR }
  Instrument              class + Builder (Long id, Ticker ticker, String name, InstrumentType type,
                                           String sector, String exchange, Currency currency)
  Broker                  record (Long id, String name)
  TransactionType         enum { BUY, SELL }
  Transaction             class + Builder (Long id, Ticker ticker, String brokerName, TransactionType type,
                                           Quantity quantity, Money unitPrice, Money fees, LocalDate tradedAt)
  Position                class + Builder (Ticker ticker, String brokerName, Quantity quantity,
                                           Money totalCost, Money averageCost, Money realizedPnl)
                          + static fromTransactions(Ticker, String, List<Transaction>)
                          + static deriveAll(List<Transaction>) -> List<Position>  // open only
  Quote                   record (Ticker ticker, Money price, Percentage dayChangePercent)
  ValuedPosition          class + Builder (Position position, Money marketValue, Money unrealizedPnl,
                                           Percentage unrealizedPnlPercent, Percentage dayChangePercent)
  PortfolioValuation      class + Builder (List<ValuedPosition> positions, Money totalInvested,
                                           Money totalMarketValue, Money totalUnrealizedPnl)
  MarketSegment           enum { USD_ASSETS(USD), TRII_ADR(USD), BVC_COLOMBIA(COP) }
  ReturnSegment           class + Builder (MarketSegment segment, Money invested, Money marketValue,
                                           Money assetGain)
  TotalReturn             class + Builder (List<ReturnSegment> segments, ExchangeRate baseRate,
                                           ExchangeRate currentRate, Money exchangeEffect,
                                           Money assetGainInCop, Money totalReturnInCop)
  SignalSource            enum { TECHNICAL(0.30), NEWS(0.20), ANALYST(0.15), INSIDER(0.15),
                                 SOCIAL(0.10), WSB(0.10) }
  SignalSnapshot          class + Builder (Ticker ticker, LocalDate snapshotDate,
                                           Map<SignalSource, BigDecimal> scores)
  SignalLevel             enum { STRONG_BUY, BUY, HOLD, SELL, STRONG_SELL }
  CombinedScore           record (BigDecimal value, SignalLevel level, Set<SignalSource> usedSources)
  DiversificationLimit    enum { SINGLE_EQUITY(20), SINGLE_ETF(25), SECTOR(30) }
  DiversificationViolation record (DiversificationLimit limit, String subject,
                                   Percentage actualWeight, Percentage allowedWeight)
  DiversificationReport   class + Builder (List<DiversificationViolation> violations, Money totalMarketValue,
                                           Map<String, Percentage> weightByTicker,
                                           Map<String, Percentage> weightBySector)
  TickerSignal            record (Ticker ticker, SignalSnapshot snapshot, CombinedScore score)
  SignalsDashboard        class + Builder (List<TickerSignal> signals, BigDecimal averageScore,
                                           Map<SignalLevel, Integer> levelCounts,
                                           List<Ticker> tickersWithoutData)
  User                    class + Builder (Long id, String username, String passwordHash)
  AuthenticatedSession    record (String token, Instant expiresAt, String username)

model/exception/
  DomainException          abstract RuntimeException
  CurrencyMismatchException, InvalidTickerException, InvalidQuantityException,
  InsufficientPositionException, UnknownInstrumentException, InvalidTradeDateException,
  TransactionNotFoundException, InvalidCredentialsException

model/gateways/   (ports — interfaces only; this plan creates these ten)
  TransactionRepository, InstrumentRepository, UserRepository, SignalSnapshotRepository,
  QuoteProvider, ExchangeRateProvider, SignalProvider, TokenProvider, PasswordHasher, TimeProvider

usecase/transaction/   TransactionFilter record (Ticker, String brokerName, LocalDate from, LocalDate to)

The four remaining ports of the spec — `AiSynthesisProvider`, `EarningsProvider`,
`WatchlistProvider`, `FundamentalsProvider` — plus `ExchangeRateRepository` belong to Plan 2, which
creates them alongside the pass-through use cases that read them. They are deliberately absent here.
```

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model.exception;

import co.com.david.inversiones.model.Currency;

/** Raised when an arithmetic operation mixes two different currencies. */
public class CurrencyMismatchException extends DomainException {

    public CurrencyMismatchException(Currency left, Currency right) {
        super("Cannot operate on amounts in different currencies: %s and %s".formatted(left, right));
    }
}
```

`Currency.java`:

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

/** Currencies the portfolio operates in. */
public enum Currency {
    USD,
    COP
}
```

`Money.java`:

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

import co.com.david.inversiones.model.exception.CurrencyMismatchException;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * A monetary amount in a specific currency.
 *
 * <p>Amounts are normalized to scale {@value #SCALE} with {@link RoundingMode#HALF_UP} so that two
 * amounts representing the same value are always equal, regardless of the scale they were created
 * with. Arithmetic between different currencies is rejected rather than silently coerced.
 */
public record Money(BigDecimal amount, Currency currency) implements Comparable<Money> {

    /** Scale every amount is normalized to. */
    public static final int SCALE = 10;

    public Money {
        Objects.requireNonNull(amount, "amount must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(currency, "currency must not be null");
        amount = amount.setScale(SCALE, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    public static Money of(BigDecimal amount, Currency currency) {
        return new Money(amount, currency);
    }

    public static Money usd(String amount) {
        return new Money(new BigDecimal(amount), Currency.USD);
    }

    public static Money cop(String amount) {
        return new Money(new BigDecimal(amount), Currency.COP);
    }

    public static Money zero(Currency currency) {
        return new Money(BigDecimal.ZERO, currency);
    }

    public Money add(Money other) {
        requireSameCurrency(other);
        return new Money(amount.add(other.amount), currency);
    }

    public Money subtract(Money other) {
        requireSameCurrency(other);
        return new Money(amount.subtract(other.amount), currency);
    }

    public Money multiply(BigDecimal factor) {
        return new Money(amount.multiply(factor), currency);
    }

    /** Divides this amount, rounding half up at scale {@value #SCALE}. */
    public Money divide(BigDecimal divisor) {
        return new Money(amount.divide(divisor, SCALE, RoundingMode.HALF_UP), currency);
    }

    public Money negate() {
        return new Money(amount.negate(), currency);
    }

    public boolean isNegative() {
        return amount.signum() < 0;
    }

    public boolean isZero() {
        return amount.signum() == 0;
    }

    @Override
    public int compareTo(Money other) {
        requireSameCurrency(other);
        return amount.compareTo(other.amount);
    }

    private void requireSameCurrency(Money other) {
        if (currency != other.currency) {
            throw new CurrencyMismatchException(currency, other.currency);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

import co.com.david.inversiones.model.exception.InvalidTickerException;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

class TickerTest {

    @Test
    void normalizesToTrimmedUppercase() {
        assertThat(Ticker.of("  tsla ").symbol()).isEqualTo("TSLA");
    }

    @Test
    void equalTickersAreEqualRegardlessOfInputCasing() {
        assertThat(Ticker.of("googl")).isEqualTo(Ticker.of("GOOGL"));
    }

    @Test
    void acceptsSymbolsWithDotsAndHyphens() {
        assertThat(Ticker.of("BRK.B").symbol()).isEqualTo("BRK.B");
    }

    @ParameterizedTest
    @ValueSource(strings = {"", "   ", "1TSLA", "TOOLONGSYMBOL", "TS LA", "TS$"})
    void rejectsMalformedSymbols(String candidate) {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> Ticker.of(candidate))
                .isInstanceOf(InvalidTickerException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsNull() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> Ticker.of(null)).isInstanceOf(InvalidTickerException.class);
    }
}
```

`ExchangeRateTest.java`:

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

import co.com.david.inversiones.model.exception.CurrencyMismatchException;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

class ExchangeRateTest {

    private static final LocalDate DATE = LocalDate.of(2026, 9, 29);

    @Test
    void convertsUsdIntoCop() {
        ExchangeRate rate = ExchangeRate.copPerUsd(new BigDecimal("3912.40"), DATE);
        assertThat(rate.convert(Money.usd("100")).amount()).isEqualByComparingTo("391240");
        assertThat(rate.convert(Money.usd("100")).currency()).isEqualTo(Currency.COP);
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsConvertingAnAmountThatIsNotInTheBaseCurrency() {
        ExchangeRate rate = ExchangeRate.copPerUsd(new BigDecimal("3912.40"), DATE);
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> rate.convert(Money.cop("100")))
                .isInstanceOf(CurrencyMismatchException.class);
    }

    @Test
    void reportsTheDifferenceAgainstAReferenceRate() {
        ExchangeRate current = ExchangeRate.copPerUsd(new BigDecimal("3912.40"), DATE);
        ExchangeRate base = ExchangeRate.copPerUsd(new BigDecimal("3568.42"), DATE.minusYears(1));
        assertThat(current.difference(base)).isEqualByComparingTo("343.98");
    }
}
```

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

import co.com.david.inversiones.model.exception.InvalidTickerException;

import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * A market symbol, normalized to trimmed uppercase.
 *
 * <p>Accepts one to ten characters starting with a letter, allowing dots and hyphens for share
 * classes and foreign listings (for example {@code BRK.B}).
 */
public record Ticker(String symbol) {

    private static final Pattern VALID = Pattern.compile("^[A-Z][A-Z0-9.\\-]{0,9}$");

    /**
     * Normalizes and validates in the canonical constructor, so that no construction path — factory
     * or {@code new} — can produce an unvalidated ticker.
     */
    public Ticker {
        if (symbol == null) {
            throw new InvalidTickerException("null");
        }
        String normalized = symbol.trim().toUpperCase();
        if (!VALID.matcher(normalized).matches()) {
            throw new InvalidTickerException(symbol);
        }
        symbol = normalized;
    }

    /** @throws InvalidTickerException when {@code candidate} is not a valid market symbol */
    public static Ticker of(String candidate) {
        return new Ticker(candidate);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return symbol;
    }
}
```

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

import co.com.david.inversiones.model.exception.InvalidQuantityException;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;

/**
 * A non-negative number of shares, supporting fractional holdings.
 *
 * <p>Normalized to scale {@value #SCALE} so that equal quantities are equal.
 */
public record Quantity(BigDecimal value) implements Comparable<Quantity> {

    public static final int SCALE = 10;

    public Quantity {
        if (value == null) {
            throw new InvalidQuantityException("Quantity must not be null");
        }
        if (value.signum() < 0) {
            throw new InvalidQuantityException("Quantity must not be negative: " + value);
        }
        value = value.setScale(SCALE, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    public static Quantity of(BigDecimal value) {
        return new Quantity(value);
    }

    public static Quantity of(String value) {
        return new Quantity(new BigDecimal(value));
    }

    public static Quantity zero() {
        return new Quantity(BigDecimal.ZERO);
    }

    public Quantity add(Quantity other) {
        return new Quantity(value.add(other.value));
    }

    /** @throws InvalidQuantityException when the result would be negative. */
    public Quantity subtract(Quantity other) {
        BigDecimal result = value.subtract(other.value);
        if (result.signum() < 0) {
            throw new InvalidQuantityException(
                    "Cannot subtract %s from %s: result would be negative".formatted(other.value, value));
        }
        return new Quantity(result);
    }

    public boolean isZero() {
        return value.signum() == 0;
    }

    public boolean isGreaterThan(Quantity other) {
        return value.compareTo(other.value) > 0;
    }

    @Override
    public int compareTo(Quantity other) {
        return value.compareTo(other.value);
    }
}
```

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;

/**
 * A percentage expressed in percent units: a value of {@code 13.33} means 13.33%.
 *
 * <p>Normalized to scale {@value #SCALE}, which is enough precision for display and comparison
 * without accumulating rounding noise.
 */
public record Percentage(BigDecimal value) {

    public static final int SCALE = 4;

    private static final BigDecimal ONE_HUNDRED = new BigDecimal("100");

    public Percentage {
        value = value == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO : value.setScale(SCALE, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    public static Percentage of(BigDecimal value) {
        return new Percentage(value);
    }

    public static Percentage of(String value) {
        return new Percentage(new BigDecimal(value));
    }

    public static Percentage zero() {
        return new Percentage(BigDecimal.ZERO);
    }

    /**
     * The share {@code part} represents of {@code whole}, in percent units.
     *
     * <p>Returns zero when {@code whole} is zero rather than dividing by zero, which is the correct
     * reading for an empty portfolio or a position with no cost basis.
     */
    public static Percentage between(Money part, Money whole) {
        if (whole.isZero()) {
            return zero();
        }
        return new Percentage(part.amount()
                .multiply(ONE_HUNDRED)
                .divide(whole.amount(), SCALE, RoundingMode.HALF_UP));
    }
}
```

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

import co.com.david.inversiones.model.exception.CurrencyMismatchException;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * A currency conversion rate valid on a given date.
 *
 * <p>The rate is expressed as units of {@code quote} per one unit of {@code base}. For the
 * Colombian market this is the TRM: COP per USD.
 */
public record ExchangeRate(Currency base, Currency quote, BigDecimal rate, LocalDate rateDate) {

    public ExchangeRate {
        Objects.requireNonNull(base, "base must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(quote, "quote must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(rate, "rate must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(rateDate, "rateDate must not be null");
    }

    /** The Colombian TRM: Colombian pesos per one US dollar. */
    public static ExchangeRate copPerUsd(BigDecimal rate, LocalDate rateDate) {
        return new ExchangeRate(Currency.USD, Currency.COP, rate, rateDate);
    }

    /** @throws CurrencyMismatchException when {@code amount} is not in the base currency. */
    public Money convert(Money amount) {
        if (amount.currency() != base) {
            throw new CurrencyMismatchException(base, amount.currency());
        }
        return Money.of(amount.amount().multiply(rate), quote);
    }

    /** How many quote-currency units this rate sits above {@code reference}. */
    public BigDecimal difference(ExchangeRate reference) {
        return rate.subtract(reference.rate());
    }
}
```

**Files:**
- Create: `model/InstrumentType.java`, `model/Instrument.java`, `model/Broker.java`, `model/TransactionType.java`, `model/Transaction.java`
- Test: `model/TransactionTest.java`, `model/InstrumentTest.java`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Ticker`, `Money`, `Quantity`, `Currency` (Tasks 2–3).
- Produces:
  - `InstrumentType` enum `EQUITY`, `ETF`, `ADR`, with `boolean isFund()` returning true only for `ETF`.
  - `Instrument` with `builder()` and accessors `id()`, `ticker()`, `name()`, `type()`, `sector()`, `exchange()`, `currency()`.
  - `Broker` record `(Long id, String name)`.
  - `TransactionType` enum `BUY`, `SELL`.
  - `Transaction` with `builder()`, accessors `id()`, `ticker()`, `brokerName()`, `type()`, `quantity()`, `unitPrice()`, `fees()`, `tradedAt()`, plus `Money grossAmount()` and `Money netAmount()`.

**Builder convention.** `Transaction.Builder` below is the canonical hand-written builder for this codebase. Every other `domain/model` builder in this plan follows it exactly: a private constructor taking the builder, a static `builder()`, one fluent setter per field named after the field, and a `build()` that validates required fields with `Objects.requireNonNull` before constructing. Do not use Lombok in `domain`.

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

import java.util.Objects;

/** A tradable instrument the portfolio can hold. */
public final class Instrument {

    private final Long id;
    private final Ticker ticker;
    private final String name;
    private final InstrumentType type;
    private final String sector;
    private final String exchange;
    private final Currency currency;

    private Instrument(Builder builder) {
        this.id = builder.id;
        this.ticker = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.ticker, "ticker must not be null");
        this.name = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.name, "name must not be null");
        this.type = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.type, "type must not be null");
        this.sector = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.sector, "sector must not be null");
        this.exchange = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.exchange, "exchange must not be null");
        this.currency = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.currency, "currency must not be null");
    }

    public static Builder builder() {
        return new Builder();
    }

    public Long id() {
        return id;
    }

    public Ticker ticker() {
        return ticker;
    }

    public String name() {
        return name;
    }

    public InstrumentType type() {
        return type;
    }

    public String sector() {
        return sector;
    }

    public String exchange() {
        return exchange;
    }

    public Currency currency() {
        return currency;
    }

    /** Fluent builder for {@link Instrument}. */
    public static final class Builder {

        private Long id;
        private Ticker ticker;
        private String name;
        private InstrumentType type;
        private String sector;
        private String exchange;
        private Currency currency;

        private Builder() {
        }

        public Builder id(Long id) {
            this.id = id;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder ticker(Ticker ticker) {
            this.ticker = ticker;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder name(String name) {
            this.name = name;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder type(InstrumentType type) {
            this.type = type;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder sector(String sector) {
            this.sector = sector;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder exchange(String exchange) {
            this.exchange = exchange;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder currency(Currency currency) {
            this.currency = currency;
            return this;
        }

        public Instrument build() {
            return new Instrument(this);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * A single executed trade: one lot bought or sold at one broker on one date.
 *
 * <p>Positions are always derived from transactions, never stored directly, so that the weighted
 * average cost and the realized profit can be recomputed from the record of what actually happened.
 */
public final class Transaction {

    private final Long id;
    private final Ticker ticker;
    private final String brokerName;
    private final TransactionType type;
    private final Quantity quantity;
    private final Money unitPrice;
    private final Money fees;
    private final LocalDate tradedAt;

    private Transaction(Builder builder) {
        this.id = builder.id;
        this.ticker = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.ticker, "ticker must not be null");
        this.brokerName = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.brokerName, "brokerName must not be null");
        this.type = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.type, "type must not be null");
        this.quantity = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.quantity, "quantity must not be null");
        this.unitPrice = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.unitPrice, "unitPrice must not be null");
        this.tradedAt = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.tradedAt, "tradedAt must not be null");
        this.fees = builder.fees == null ? Money.zero(this.unitPrice.currency()) : builder.fees;
        // Raises CurrencyMismatchException when fees are not in the trade currency.
        this.unitPrice.add(this.fees);
    }

    public static Builder builder() {
        return new Builder();
    }

    /** Quantity times unit price, before fees. */
    public Money grossAmount() {
        return unitPrice.multiply(quantity.value());
    }

    /** What the trade actually moved: gross plus fees on a purchase, gross minus fees on a sale. */
    public Money netAmount() {
        return type == TransactionType.BUY
                ? grossAmount().add(fees)
                : grossAmount().subtract(fees);
    }

    public Long id() {
        return id;
    }

    public Ticker ticker() {
        return ticker;
    }

    public String brokerName() {
        return brokerName;
    }

    public TransactionType type() {
        return type;
    }

    public Quantity quantity() {
        return quantity;
    }

    public Money unitPrice() {
        return unitPrice;
    }

    public Money fees() {
        return fees;
    }

    public LocalDate tradedAt() {
        return tradedAt;
    }

    /** Fluent builder for {@link Transaction}. */
    public static final class Builder {

        private Long id;
        private Ticker ticker;
        private String brokerName;
        private TransactionType type;
        private Quantity quantity;
        private Money unitPrice;
        private Money fees;
        private LocalDate tradedAt;

        private Builder() {
        }

        public Builder id(Long id) {
            this.id = id;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder ticker(Ticker ticker) {
            this.ticker = ticker;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder brokerName(String brokerName) {
            this.brokerName = brokerName;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder type(TransactionType type) {
            this.type = type;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder quantity(Quantity quantity) {
            this.quantity = quantity;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder unitPrice(Money unitPrice) {
            this.unitPrice = unitPrice;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder fees(Money fees) {
            this.fees = fees;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder tradedAt(LocalDate tradedAt) {
            this.tradedAt = tradedAt;
            return this;
        }

        public Transaction build() {
            return new Transaction(this);
        }
    }
}
```

### Task 5: Position with weighted average cost

**Files:**
- Create: `model/Position.java`, `model/exception/InsufficientPositionException.java`
- Test: `model/PositionTest.java`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Transaction`, `Ticker`, `Quantity`, `Money` (Tasks 2–4).
- Produces: `Position.fromTransactions(Ticker ticker, String brokerName, List<Transaction> transactions)`, `Position.deriveAll(List<Transaction> transactions)`, plus `Position.builder()` and accessors `ticker()`, `brokerName()`, `quantity()`, `totalCost()`, `averageCost()`, `realizedPnl()`, and `boolean isOpen()`.

`deriveAll` is the **single** place that knows a holding is identified by ticker *and* broker. Tasks 7 and 10 both need "the positions implied by this transaction history", and each writing its own grouping would put that identity rule in three places. It groups by the pair, replays each group through `fromTransactions`, and returns only the open positions.

**The rule being encoded.** A purchase adds to quantity and to total cost. A sale removes shares **at the current average cost**, so the average cost never changes on a sale; the difference between the sale proceeds and the cost removed becomes realized profit. This is weighted average cost accounting, and it is what makes the reported unrealized profit correct after a partial sale. Selling more than is held is an error, not a negative position.

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

import co.com.david.inversiones.model.exception.InsufficientPositionException;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.List;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

class PositionTest {

    private static final Ticker QQQ = Ticker.of("QQQ");
    private static final String HAPI = "Hapi";

    private static Transaction trade(TransactionType type, String quantity, String unitPrice, int dayOfMonth) {
        return Transaction.builder()
                .ticker(QQQ)
                .brokerName(HAPI)
                .type(type)
                .quantity(Quantity.of(quantity))
                .unitPrice(Money.usd(unitPrice))
                .tradedAt(LocalDate.of(2026, 6, dayOfMonth))
                .build();
    }

    @Test
    void aSinglePurchaseSetsAverageCostToTheUnitPrice() {
        Position position = Position.fromTransactions(QQQ, HAPI,
                List.of(trade(TransactionType.BUY, "2", "100.00", 1)));

        assertThat(position.quantity()).isEqualTo(Quantity.of("2"));
        assertThat(position.totalCost()).isEqualTo(Money.usd("200.00"));
        assertThat(position.averageCost().amount()).isEqualByComparingTo("100");
        assertThat(position.realizedPnl()).isEqualTo(Money.zero(Currency.USD));
    }

    @Test
    void twoPurchasesAtDifferentPricesWeightTheAverageCostByQuantity() {
        Position position = Position.fromTransactions(QQQ, HAPI, List.of(
                trade(TransactionType.BUY, "1", "100.00", 1),
                trade(TransactionType.BUY, "3", "200.00", 2)));

        assertThat(position.quantity()).isEqualTo(Quantity.of("4"));
        assertThat(position.totalCost()).isEqualTo(Money.usd("700.00"));
        assertThat(position.averageCost().amount()).isEqualByComparingTo("175");
    }

    @Test
    void aPartialSaleLeavesAverageCostUnchangedAndRealizesTheGain() {
        Position position = Position.fromTransactions(QQQ, HAPI, List.of(
                trade(TransactionType.BUY, "1", "100.00", 1),
                trade(TransactionType.BUY, "3", "200.00", 2),
                trade(TransactionType.SELL, "2", "250.00", 3)));

        assertThat(position.quantity()).isEqualTo(Quantity.of("2"));
        assertThat(position.averageCost().amount()).isEqualByComparingTo("175");
        assertThat(position.totalCost().amount()).isEqualByComparingTo("350");
        // Sold 2 at 250 (500) against a cost basis of 2 x 175 (350).
        assertThat(position.realizedPnl().amount()).isEqualByComparingTo("150");
    }

    @Test
    void feesReduceTheProceedsOfASale() {
        Transaction saleWithFees = Transaction.builder()
                .ticker(QQQ).brokerName(HAPI).type(TransactionType.SELL)
                .quantity(Quantity.of("1")).unitPrice(Money.usd("250.00"))
                .fees(Money.usd("2.00")).tradedAt(LocalDate.of(2026, 6, 3))
                .build();

        Position position = Position.fromTransactions(QQQ, HAPI,
                List.of(trade(TransactionType.BUY, "1", "100.00", 1), saleWithFees));

        assertThat(position.realizedPnl().amount()).isEqualByComparingTo("148");
        assertThat(position.isOpen()).isFalse();
    }

    @Test
    void sellingEverythingClosesThePosition() {
        Position position = Position.fromTransactions(QQQ, HAPI, List.of(
                trade(TransactionType.BUY, "2", "100.00", 1),
                trade(TransactionType.SELL, "2", "150.00", 2)));

        assertThat(position.quantity().isZero()).isTrue();
        assertThat(position.totalCost().isZero()).isTrue();
        assertThat(position.isOpen()).isFalse();
        assertThat(position.realizedPnl().amount()).isEqualByComparingTo("100");
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsSellingMoreSharesThanAreHeld() {
        assertThatThrownBy(() -> Position.fromTransactions(QQQ, HAPI, List.of(
                trade(TransactionType.BUY, "1", "100.00", 1),
                trade(TransactionType.SELL, "2", "150.00", 2))))
                .isInstanceOf(InsufficientPositionException.class)
                .hasMessageContaining("QQQ");

    @Test

        Transaction vooSellAll = Transaction.builder()
                .ticker(voo).brokerName(HAPI).type(TransactionType.SELL)
                .quantity(Quantity.of("1")).unitPrice(Money.usd("610.00"))
                .tradedAt(LocalDate.of(2026, 6, 2)).build();

        List<Position> positions =
                Position.deriveAll(List.of(qqqHapi, qqqArq, vooBuy, vooSellAll));

        assertThat(positions).hasSize(2);
        assertThat(positions).allMatch(Position::isOpen);
        assertThat(positions)
                .extracting(position -> position.ticker().symbol() + "@" + position.brokerName())
                .containsExactlyInAnyOrder("QQQ@Hapi", "QQQ@ARQ");
    }

    @Test
    void deriveAllOnAnEmptyHistoryProducesNoPositions() {
        assertThat(Position.deriveAll(List.of())).isEmpty();
    }

    @Test
    void anEmptyTransactionListProducesAClosedPositionAtZeroCost() {
        Position position = Position.fromTransactions(QQQ, HAPI, List.of());

        assertThat(position.isOpen()).isFalse();
        assertThat(position.quantity().isZero()).isTrue();
        assertThat(position.averageCost()).isEqualTo(Money.zero(Currency.USD));
    }
```

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model.exception;

import co.com.david.inversiones.model.Ticker;

/** Raised when a sale would remove more shares than the position holds. */
public class InsufficientPositionException extends DomainException {

    public InsufficientPositionException(Ticker ticker, String brokerName, String held, String requested) {
        super("Cannot sell %s shares of %s at %s: only %s held"
                .formatted(requested, ticker.symbol(), brokerName, held));
    }
}
```

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

import co.com.david.inversiones.model.exception.InsufficientPositionException;

import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * A holding of one instrument at one broker, derived from its transactions.
 *
 * <p>Uses weighted average cost accounting: a purchase raises the average cost proportionally to the
 * quantity added, while a sale removes shares at the prevailing average cost and turns the
 * difference against the sale proceeds into realized profit, leaving the average cost untouched.
 */
public final class Position {

    private final Ticker ticker;
    private final String brokerName;
    private final Quantity quantity;
    private final Money totalCost;
    private final Money averageCost;
    private final Money realizedPnl;

    private Position(Builder builder) {
        this.ticker = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.ticker, "ticker must not be null");
        this.brokerName = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.brokerName, "brokerName must not be null");
        this.quantity = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.quantity, "quantity must not be null");
        this.totalCost = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.totalCost, "totalCost must not be null");
        this.averageCost = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.averageCost, "averageCost must not be null");
        this.realizedPnl = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.realizedPnl, "realizedPnl must not be null");
    }

    public static Builder builder() {
        return new Builder();
    }

    /**
     * Replays the transactions in trade-date order to derive the current holding.
     *
     * @throws InsufficientPositionException when a sale exceeds the quantity held at that point
     */
    public static Position fromTransactions(Ticker ticker, String brokerName, List<Transaction> transactions) {
        Currency currency = transactions.isEmpty()
                ? Currency.USD
                : transactions.getFirst().unitPrice().currency();

        Quantity quantity = Quantity.zero();
        Money totalCost = Money.zero(currency);
        Money realizedPnl = Money.zero(currency);

        List<Transaction> ordered = transactions.stream()
                .sorted(Comparator.comparing(Transaction::tradedAt))
                .toList();

        for (Transaction transaction : ordered) {
            if (transaction.type() == TransactionType.BUY) {
                quantity = quantity.add(transaction.quantity());
                totalCost = totalCost.add(transaction.netAmount());
                continue;
            }
            if (transaction.quantity().isGreaterThan(quantity)) {
                throw new InsufficientPositionException(ticker, brokerName,
                        quantity.value().toPlainString(), transaction.quantity().value().toPlainString());
            }
            Money averageCost = averageCostOf(totalCost, quantity, currency);
            Money costRemoved = averageCost.multiply(transaction.quantity().value());
            realizedPnl = realizedPnl.add(transaction.netAmount().subtract(costRemoved));
            quantity = quantity.subtract(transaction.quantity());
            totalCost = quantity.isZero() ? Money.zero(currency) : totalCost.subtract(costRemoved);
        }

        return builder()
                .ticker(ticker)
                .brokerName(brokerName)
                .quantity(quantity)
                .totalCost(totalCost)
                .averageCost(averageCostOf(totalCost, quantity, currency))
                .realizedPnl(realizedPnl)
                .build();
    }

    /**
     * Every open holding implied by a transaction history.
     *
     * <p>A holding is identified by ticker <em>and</em> broker: the same instrument bought at two
     * brokers has two independent cost bases. This method is the single place that knows that rule,
     * so callers never group transactions themselves. Fully sold holdings are omitted.
     */
    public static List<Position> deriveAll(List<Transaction> transactions) {
        Map<PositionKey, List<Transaction>> grouped = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (Transaction transaction : transactions) {
            grouped.computeIfAbsent(
                            new PositionKey(transaction.ticker(), transaction.brokerName()),
                            key -> new java.util.ArrayList<>())
                    .add(transaction);
        }
        return grouped.entrySet().stream()
                .map(entry -> fromTransactions(
                        entry.getKey().ticker(), entry.getKey().brokerName(), entry.getValue()))
                .filter(Position::isOpen)
                .toList();
    }

    private static Money averageCostOf(Money totalCost, Quantity quantity, Currency currency) {
        return quantity.isZero() ? Money.zero(currency) : totalCost.divide(quantity.value());
    }

    /** Identity of a holding: ticker plus broker, since each broker carries its own cost basis. */
    private record PositionKey(Ticker ticker, String brokerName) {
    }

    /** Whether any shares are still held. */
    public boolean isOpen() {
        return !quantity.isZero();
    }

    public Ticker ticker() {
        return ticker;
    }

    public String brokerName() {
        return brokerName;
    }

    public Quantity quantity() {
        return quantity;
    }

    public Money totalCost() {
        return totalCost;
    }

    public Money averageCost() {
        return averageCost;
    }

    public Money realizedPnl() {
        return realizedPnl;
    }

    /** Fluent builder for {@link Position}, following the convention of {@code Transaction.Builder}. */
    public static final class Builder {

        private Ticker ticker;
        private String brokerName;
        private Quantity quantity;
        private Money totalCost;
        private Money averageCost;
        private Money realizedPnl;

        private Builder() {
        }

        public Builder ticker(Ticker ticker) {
            this.ticker = ticker;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder brokerName(String brokerName) {
            this.brokerName = brokerName;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder quantity(Quantity quantity) {
            this.quantity = quantity;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder totalCost(Money totalCost) {
            this.totalCost = totalCost;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder averageCost(Money averageCost) {
            this.averageCost = averageCost;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder realizedPnl(Money realizedPnl) {
            this.realizedPnl = realizedPnl;
            return this;
        }

        public Position build() {
            return new Position(this);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model.gateways;

public interface TransactionRepository {
    List<Transaction> findAll();
    List<Transaction> findByTickerAndBroker(Ticker ticker, String brokerName);
    Optional<Transaction> findById(Long id);
    Transaction save(Transaction transaction);
    void deleteById(Long id);
}

public interface InstrumentRepository {
    Optional<Instrument> findByTicker(Ticker ticker);
    List<Instrument> findAll();
}

public interface TimeProvider {
    LocalDate today();
    Instant now();
}
```

- Produces the use cases: `RegisterTransactionUseCase.execute(Transaction) -> Transaction`, `UpdateTransactionUseCase.execute(Long id, Transaction) -> Transaction`, `DeleteTransactionUseCase.execute(Long id)`, `ListTransactionsUseCase.execute(TransactionFilter) -> List<Transaction>`, and the record `TransactionFilter(Ticker ticker, String brokerName, LocalDate from, LocalDate to)` where every field is nullable and a null field means "do not filter on it".

**The rules being encoded.** A transaction can only reference a known instrument. A trade cannot be dated in the future. A sale cannot exceed the shares held at that point in the history — which is validated by replaying the whole history for that ticker and broker with the candidate included, reusing `Position.fromTransactions` rather than duplicating the arithmetic. Editing or deleting a transaction runs the same replay against the resulting history, so the record can never be left in a state that would make a position negative.

An edit may not change which instrument or broker the trade belongs to. `Position.fromTransactions` replays whatever list it is handed without filtering by ticker or broker, so validating a replacement that moved to a different pair against the old pair's remaining history would replay a meaningless mixture and prove nothing about either position. Changing the instrument is not an edit of a trade — it is a deletion and a new trade — so `UpdateTransactionUseCase` rejects it outright with `InvalidTransactionUpdateException`.

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.usecase.transaction;

import co.com.david.inversiones.model.Position;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.Transaction;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.TransactionType;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.exception.InvalidTradeDateException;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.exception.UnknownInstrumentException;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.gateways.InstrumentRepository;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.gateways.TimeProvider;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.gateways.TransactionRepository;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Records a trade after checking that it is consistent with the existing history.
 *
 * <p>A sale is validated by replaying the whole history for that ticker and broker with the candidate
 * included, which reuses the weighted average cost rules of {@link Position} instead of duplicating
 * them here.
 */
public class RegisterTransactionUseCase {

    private final TransactionRepository transactionRepository;
    private final InstrumentRepository instrumentRepository;
    private final TimeProvider timeProvider;

    public RegisterTransactionUseCase(TransactionRepository transactionRepository,
                                      InstrumentRepository instrumentRepository,
                                      TimeProvider timeProvider) {
        this.transactionRepository = transactionRepository;
        this.instrumentRepository = instrumentRepository;
        this.timeProvider = timeProvider;
    }

    public Transaction execute(Transaction candidate) {
        instrumentRepository.findByTicker(candidate.ticker())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new UnknownInstrumentException(candidate.ticker()));

        if (candidate.tradedAt().isAfter(timeProvider.today())) {
            throw new InvalidTradeDateException(candidate.tradedAt(), timeProvider.today());
        }

        if (candidate.type() == TransactionType.SELL) {
            List<Transaction> history = new ArrayList<>(
                    transactionRepository.findByTickerAndBroker(candidate.ticker(), candidate.brokerName()));
            history.add(candidate);
            Position.fromTransactions(candidate.ticker(), candidate.brokerName(), history);
        }

        return transactionRepository.save(candidate);
    }
}
```

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.usecase.transaction;

import co.com.david.inversiones.model.Position;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.Transaction;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.exception.TransactionNotFoundException;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.gateways.TransactionRepository;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Removes a trade, refusing the deletion when the remaining history would no longer be valid.
 *
 * <p>Deleting a purchase that a later sale depends on would leave a negative position, so the
 * resulting history is replayed before anything is removed.
 */
public class DeleteTransactionUseCase {

    private final TransactionRepository transactionRepository;

    public DeleteTransactionUseCase(TransactionRepository transactionRepository) {
        this.transactionRepository = transactionRepository;
    }

    public void execute(Long id) {
        Transaction target = transactionRepository.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new TransactionNotFoundException(id));

        List<Transaction> remaining = transactionRepository
                .findByTickerAndBroker(target.ticker(), target.brokerName())
                .stream()
                .filter(transaction -> !Objects.equals(transaction.id(), id))
                .toList();

        Position.fromTransactions(target.ticker(), target.brokerName(), remaining);

        transactionRepository.deleteById(id);
    }
}
```

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.usecase.transaction;

import co.com.david.inversiones.model.Position;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.Transaction;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.exception.InvalidTransactionUpdateException;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.exception.TransactionNotFoundException;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.gateways.TransactionRepository;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Replaces a trade, validating the resulting history the same way a deletion does.
 *
 * <p>The instrument and broker of a trade are immutable. {@link Position#fromTransactions} replays
 * whatever list it is handed without filtering by ticker or broker, so validating a replacement that
 * moved to a different pair against the old pair's remaining history would replay a meaningless
 * mixture and prove nothing about either position. Moving a trade to another instrument is a
 * deletion plus a new trade, not an edit, so it is rejected.
 */
public class UpdateTransactionUseCase {

    private final TransactionRepository transactionRepository;

    public UpdateTransactionUseCase(TransactionRepository transactionRepository) {
        this.transactionRepository = transactionRepository;
    }

    public Transaction execute(Long id, Transaction replacement) {
        Transaction existing = transactionRepository.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new TransactionNotFoundException(id));

        if (!existing.ticker().equals(replacement.ticker())
                || !existing.brokerName().equals(replacement.brokerName())) {
            throw new InvalidTransactionUpdateException(existing, replacement);
        }

        List<Transaction> history = new ArrayList<>(transactionRepository
                .findByTickerAndBroker(existing.ticker(), existing.brokerName())
                .stream()
                .filter(transaction -> !Objects.equals(transaction.id(), id))
                .toList());
        history.add(replacement);

        Position.fromTransactions(existing.ticker(), existing.brokerName(), history);

        return transactionRepository.save(replacement);
    }
}
```

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.usecase.transaction;

import co.com.david.inversiones.model.Ticker;

import java.time.LocalDate;

/**
 * Optional filters for listing transactions. A null field means the field is not filtered on.
 *
 * @param ticker     only transactions for this instrument
 * @param brokerName only transactions at this broker
 * @param from       only transactions traded on or after this date
 * @param to         only transactions traded on or before this date
 */
public record TransactionFilter(Ticker ticker, String brokerName, LocalDate from, LocalDate to) {

    public static TransactionFilter none() {
        return new TransactionFilter(null, null, null, null);
    }

    boolean matches(co.com.david.inversiones.model.Transaction transaction) {
        if (ticker != null && !ticker.equals(transaction.ticker())) {
            return false;
        }
        if (brokerName != null && !brokerName.equals(transaction.brokerName())) {
            return false;
        }
        if (from != null && transaction.tradedAt().isBefore(from)) {
            return false;
        }
        return to == null || !transaction.tradedAt().isAfter(to);
    }
}
```

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.usecase.transaction;

import co.com.david.inversiones.model.Transaction;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.gateways.TransactionRepository;

import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;

/** Lists trades matching a filter, most recent first. */
public class ListTransactionsUseCase {

    private final TransactionRepository transactionRepository;

    public ListTransactionsUseCase(TransactionRepository transactionRepository) {
        this.transactionRepository = transactionRepository;
    }

    public List<Transaction> execute(TransactionFilter filter) {
        return transactionRepository.findAll().stream()
                .filter(filter::matches)
                .sorted(Comparator.comparing(Transaction::tradedAt).reversed())
                .toList();
    }
}
```

### Task 7: Portfolio valuation

**Files:**
- Create: `model/Quote.java`, `model/ValuedPosition.java`, `model/PortfolioValuation.java`, `model/gateways/QuoteProvider.java`
- Create: `usecase/portfolio/GetPortfolioUseCase.java`
- Test: `usecase/portfolio/GetPortfolioUseCaseTest.java`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Position`, `Money`, `Percentage`, `Quantity`, `Ticker`, `TransactionRepository` (Tasks 2–6).
- Produces:
  - `Quote` record `(Ticker ticker, Money price, Percentage dayChangePercent)`.
  - `QuoteProvider` port: `Map<Ticker, Quote> findQuotes(Set<Ticker> tickers)` — the implementation may return fewer entries than requested when a source has no data for a ticker.
  - `ValuedPosition` with `builder()` and accessors `position()`, `marketValue()`, `unrealizedPnl()`, `unrealizedPnlPercent()`, `dayChangePercent()`, `priced()`.
  - `PortfolioValuation` with `builder()` and accessors `positions()`, `totalInvested()`, `totalMarketValue()`, `totalUnrealizedPnl()`, `unpricedTickers()`.
  - `GetPortfolioUseCase.execute() -> PortfolioValuation`.

**The rule being encoded.** Open positions are derived by grouping every transaction by ticker and broker and replaying each group. A position whose quote is missing is **not** dropped and is **not** reported as flat profit: it is carried at cost, flagged `priced() == false`, and its ticker is listed in `unpricedTickers()` so the interface can say so out loud. Silently valuing an unpriced holding at cost would understate or overstate the total without anyone noticing.

Javadoc: "A position combined with its current market price. A position with no available quote is carried at cost with {@code priced() == false}."

`PortfolioValuation` — a hand-written builder following the same convention over `List<ValuedPosition> positions`, `Money totalInvested`, `Money totalMarketValue`, `Money totalUnrealizedPnl`, `List<Ticker> unpricedTickers`. `build()` wraps both lists in `List.copyOf` so the aggregate is immutable.

- [ ] **Step 4: Write the use case**

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.usecase.portfolio;

import co.com.david.inversiones.model.*;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.gateways.QuoteProvider;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.gateways.TransactionRepository;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Derives the current portfolio from the transaction history and values it against market prices.
 *
 * <p>Position identity is owned by {@link Position#deriveAll(java.util.List)}. A position whose
 * quote is unavailable is carried at cost and reported in
 * {@link PortfolioValuation#unpricedTickers()} rather than being dropped or valued at a guess.
 */
public class GetPortfolioUseCase {

    private final TransactionRepository transactionRepository;
    private final QuoteProvider quoteProvider;

    public GetPortfolioUseCase(TransactionRepository transactionRepository, QuoteProvider quoteProvider) {
        this.transactionRepository = transactionRepository;
        this.quoteProvider = quoteProvider;
    }

    public PortfolioValuation execute() {
        List<Position> openPositions = Position.deriveAll(transactionRepository.findAll());

        Set<Ticker> tickers = openPositions.stream()
                .map(Position::ticker)
                .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableSet());
        Map<Ticker, Quote> quotes = quoteProvider.findQuotes(tickers);

        Currency currency = openPositions.isEmpty()
                ? Currency.USD
                : openPositions.getFirst().totalCost().currency();

        List<ValuedPosition> valued = openPositions.stream()
                .map(position -> value(position, quotes.get(position.ticker())))
                .toList();

        Money totalInvested = valued.stream()
                .map(v -> v.position().totalCost())
                .reduce(Money.zero(currency), Money::add);
        Money totalMarketValue = valued.stream()
                .map(ValuedPosition::marketValue)
                .reduce(Money.zero(currency), Money::add);
        Money totalUnrealizedPnl = valued.stream()
                .map(ValuedPosition::unrealizedPnl)
                .reduce(Money.zero(currency), Money::add);

        List<Ticker> unpriced = valued.stream()
                .filter(v -> !v.priced())
                .map(v -> v.position().ticker())
                .distinct()
                .toList();

        return PortfolioValuation.builder()
                .positions(valued)
                .totalInvested(totalInvested)
                .totalMarketValue(totalMarketValue)
                .totalUnrealizedPnl(totalUnrealizedPnl)
                .unpricedTickers(unpriced)
                .build();
    }

    private ValuedPosition value(Position position, Quote quote) {
        if (quote == null) {
            return ValuedPosition.builder()
                    .position(position)
                    .marketValue(position.totalCost())
                    .unrealizedPnl(Money.zero(position.totalCost().currency()))
                    .unrealizedPnlPercent(Percentage.zero())
                    .dayChangePercent(Percentage.zero())
                    .priced(false)
                    .build();
        }
        Money marketValue = quote.price().multiply(position.quantity().value());
        Money unrealizedPnl = marketValue.subtract(position.totalCost());
        return ValuedPosition.builder()
                .position(position)
                .marketValue(marketValue)
                .unrealizedPnl(unrealizedPnl)
                .unrealizedPnlPercent(Percentage.between(unrealizedPnl, position.totalCost()))
                .dayChangePercent(quote.dayChangePercent())
                .priced(true)
                .build();
    }
}
```

### Task 8: Total return with the exchange rate effect

**Files:**
- Create: `model/MarketSegment.java`, `model/ReturnSegment.java`, `model/TotalReturn.java`, `model/gateways/ExchangeRateProvider.java`
- Create: `usecase/portfolio/CalculateTotalReturnUseCase.java`
- Test: `usecase/portfolio/CalculateTotalReturnUseCaseTest.java`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `PortfolioValuation`, `ValuedPosition`, `Instrument`, `InstrumentRepository`, `ExchangeRate`, `GetPortfolioUseCase` (Tasks 3–7).
- Produces:
  - `MarketSegment` enum `USD_ASSETS`, `TRII_ADR`, `BVC_COLOMBIA`, with `Currency currency()` returning `USD` for the first two and `COP` for the third.
  - `ExchangeRateProvider` port: `ExchangeRate currentCopPerUsd()`.
  - `ReturnSegment` — builder over `MarketSegment segment`, `Money invested`, `Money marketValue`, `Money assetGain`.
  - `TotalReturn` — builder over `List<ReturnSegment> segments`, `ExchangeRate baseRate`, `ExchangeRate currentRate`, `Money exchangeEffect`, `Money assetGainInCop`, `Money totalReturnInCop`.
  - `CalculateTotalReturnUseCase(GetPortfolioUseCase, InstrumentRepository, ExchangeRateProvider, BigDecimal baseTrm)` with `execute() -> TotalReturn`. The base TRM is the weighted average purchase rate — `3568.42` today — injected as a constructor argument and wired from configuration in `app-service`, never hard-coded in the domain.

**The rule being encoded.** This is the calculation the current dashboard does in `renderResumenTotal`, and the reason it exists: the investor buys in Colombian pesos, so a dollar-denominated gain and a peso devaluation gain are two different things and must not be added into one number without being separable. Positions are split into three segments by where they trade. For the two dollar-denominated segments:

```
assetGainInCop   = (sum of segment asset gains in USD) x currentTrm
exchangeEffect   = (sum of segment invested in USD)    x (currentTrm - baseTrm)
```

The BVC segment is already in pesos, so it contributes its asset gain directly and nothing to the exchange effect. `totalReturnInCop` is the sum of all three contributions.

Segment assignment: a position at broker `Trii` whose instrument exchange is `BVC` is `BVC_COLOMBIA`; any other position at `Trii` is `TRII_ADR`; everything else is `USD_ASSETS`.

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

/** Where a holding trades, which determines whether it is exposed to the COP/USD rate. */
public enum MarketSegment {

    /** NYSE and NASDAQ holdings at Hapi and ARQ, denominated in dollars. */
    USD_ASSETS(Currency.USD),
    /** NYSE ADRs held through Trii, quoted in pesos but bought in dollars. */
    TRII_ADR(Currency.USD),
    /** Colombian stock exchange holdings, bought and quoted in pesos. */
    BVC_COLOMBIA(Currency.COP);
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Write the use case**

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.usecase.portfolio;

import co.com.david.inversiones.model.*;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.gateways.ExchangeRateProvider;
import co.com.david.inversiones.model.gateways.InstrumentRepository;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.EnumSet;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.function.Function;

/**
 * Reports the portfolio return in Colombian pesos, keeping the asset gain and the exchange rate
 * effect separate.
 *
 * <p>The investor buys in pesos and holds in dollars, so a dollar-denominated gain and a peso
 * devaluation gain are different things. Collapsing them into one number hides which of the two
 * actually produced the result, so they are reported side by side.
 */
public class CalculateTotalReturnUseCase {

    private static final String TRII = "Trii";
    private static final String BVC_EXCHANGE = "BVC";

    private final GetPortfolioUseCase getPortfolio;
    private final InstrumentRepository instrumentRepository;
    private final ExchangeRateProvider exchangeRateProvider;
    private final BigDecimal baseTrm;

    public CalculateTotalReturnUseCase(GetPortfolioUseCase getPortfolio,
                                       InstrumentRepository instrumentRepository,
                                       ExchangeRateProvider exchangeRateProvider,
                                       BigDecimal baseTrm) {
        this.getPortfolio = getPortfolio;
        this.instrumentRepository = instrumentRepository;
        this.exchangeRateProvider = exchangeRateProvider;
        this.baseTrm = baseTrm;
    }

    public TotalReturn execute() {
        PortfolioValuation valuation = getPortfolio.execute();
        ExchangeRate currentRate = exchangeRateProvider.currentCopPerUsd();

        Map<MarketSegment, List<ValuedPosition>> grouped = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (MarketSegment segment : MarketSegment.values()) {
            grouped.put(segment, new ArrayList<>());
        }
        for (ValuedPosition position : valuation.positions()) {
            grouped.get(segmentOf(position)).add(position);
        }

        List<ReturnSegment> segments = grouped.entrySet().stream()
                .filter(entry -> !entry.getValue().isEmpty())
                .map(entry -> summarize(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue()))
                .toList();

        Set<MarketSegment> dollarSegments = EnumSet.of(MarketSegment.USD_ASSETS, MarketSegment.TRII_ADR);
        Set<MarketSegment> pesoSegments = EnumSet.of(MarketSegment.BVC_COLOMBIA);

        Money assetGainUsd = sum(segments, dollarSegments, ReturnSegment::assetGain, Currency.USD);
        Money investedUsd = sum(segments, dollarSegments, ReturnSegment::invested, Currency.USD);
        Money assetGainCop = sum(segments, pesoSegments, ReturnSegment::assetGain, Currency.COP);

        Money assetGainInCop = currentRate.convert(assetGainUsd).add(assetGainCop);
        Money exchangeEffect = Money.of(
                investedUsd.amount().multiply(currentRate.rate().subtract(baseTrm)), Currency.COP);

        return TotalReturn.builder()
                .segments(segments)
                .baseRate(ExchangeRate.copPerUsd(baseTrm, currentRate.rateDate()))
                .currentRate(currentRate)
                .exchangeEffect(exchangeEffect)
                .assetGainInCop(assetGainInCop)
                .totalReturnInCop(assetGainInCop.add(exchangeEffect))
                .build();
    }

    private MarketSegment segmentOf(ValuedPosition position) {
        if (!TRII.equals(position.position().brokerName())) {
            return MarketSegment.USD_ASSETS;
        }
        boolean onBvc = instrumentRepository.findByTicker(position.position().ticker())
                .map(instrument -> BVC_EXCHANGE.equals(instrument.exchange()))
                .orElse(false);
        return onBvc ? MarketSegment.BVC_COLOMBIA : MarketSegment.TRII_ADR;
    }

    private ReturnSegment summarize(MarketSegment segment, List<ValuedPosition> positions) {
        Currency currency = segment.currency();
        Money invested = positions.stream()
                .map(position -> Money.of(position.position().totalCost().amount(), currency))
                .reduce(Money.zero(currency), Money::add);
        Money marketValue = positions.stream()
                .map(position -> Money.of(position.marketValue().amount(), currency))
                .reduce(Money.zero(currency), Money::add);
        return ReturnSegment.builder()
                .segment(segment)
                .invested(invested)
                .marketValue(marketValue)
                .assetGain(marketValue.subtract(invested))
                .build();
    }

    private Money sum(List<ReturnSegment> segments, Set<MarketSegment> included,
                      Function<ReturnSegment, Money> field, Currency currency) {
        return segments.stream()
                .filter(segment -> included.contains(segment.segment()))
                .map(field)
                .reduce(Money.zero(currency), Money::add);
    }
}
```

### Task 9: Signal scoring with proportional weight redistribution

**Files:**
- Create: `model/SignalSource.java`, `model/SignalLevel.java`, `model/CombinedScore.java`, `model/SignalSnapshot.java`
- Test: `model/SignalLevelTest.java`, `model/CombinedScoreTest.java`, `model/SignalSnapshotTest.java`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Ticker` (Task 3).
- Produces:
  - `SignalSource` enum with a `BigDecimal weight()`: `TECHNICAL` 0.30, `NEWS` 0.20, `ANALYST` 0.15, `INSIDER` 0.15, `SOCIAL` 0.10, `WSB` 0.10.
  - `SignalLevel` enum with `SignalLevel fromScore(BigDecimal)`.
  - `SignalSnapshot` — builder over `Ticker ticker`, `LocalDate snapshotDate`, `Map<SignalSource, BigDecimal> scores`; accessors plus `Optional<BigDecimal> scoreOf(SignalSource)` and `Set<SignalSource> availableSources()`. `build()` copies the map, dropping null values, so an absent source and a source explicitly reported as null are the same thing.
  - `CombinedScore` record `(BigDecimal value, SignalLevel level, Set<SignalSource> usedSources)` with the static factory `CombinedScore.from(SignalSnapshot)`.

**The rule being encoded.** This is `calcCombinedScores` from the current dashboard, and the part that is easy to get wrong. Each source carries a fixed weight and the weights sum to 1.00. When a source has no data — an ETF has no insider transactions, MiniMax timed out, Finnhub returned nothing for EC — the naive fix of treating the missing score as zero drags the total down and turns a missing reading into a sell signal. Instead the **available weights are renormalized** so they sum to 1.00 again:

```
score = sum(score_i x weight_i) / sum(weight_i)   over available sources only
```

`usedSources` records which sources actually contributed, so the interface can show that a score of 8.2 built from three sources is not the same claim as one built from six.

Thresholds: `>= 8.0` STRONG_BUY, `>= 6.5` BUY, `>= 4.5` HOLD, `>= 3.0` SELL, below that STRONG_SELL.

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

class CombinedScoreTest {

    private static final LocalDate DATE = LocalDate.of(2026, 9, 29);

    private static SignalSnapshot snapshot(Map<SignalSource, BigDecimal> scores) {
        return SignalSnapshot.builder()
                .ticker(Ticker.of("TSLA"))
                .snapshotDate(DATE)
                .scores(scores)
                .build();
    }

    @Test
    void withEverySourcePresentTheScoreIsTheWeightedAverage() {
        Map<SignalSource, BigDecimal> scores = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        scores.put(SignalSource.TECHNICAL, new BigDecimal("8"));
        scores.put(SignalSource.NEWS, new BigDecimal("7"));
        scores.put(SignalSource.ANALYST, new BigDecimal("6"));
        scores.put(SignalSource.INSIDER, new BigDecimal("5"));
        scores.put(SignalSource.SOCIAL, new BigDecimal("4"));
        scores.put(SignalSource.WSB, new BigDecimal("3"));

        CombinedScore result = CombinedScore.from(snapshot(scores));

        // 8(.30) + 7(.20) + 6(.15) + 5(.15) + 4(.10) + 3(.10) = 6.15
        assertThat(result.value()).isEqualByComparingTo("6.15");
        assertThat(result.level()).isEqualTo(SignalLevel.HOLD);
        assertThat(result.usedSources()).hasSize(6);
    }

    @Test
    void redistributesWeightProportionallyWhenSourcesAreMissing() {
        Map<SignalSource, BigDecimal> scores = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        scores.put(SignalSource.TECHNICAL, new BigDecimal("8"));
        scores.put(SignalSource.NEWS, new BigDecimal("7"));
        scores.put(SignalSource.ANALYST, new BigDecimal("6"));

        CombinedScore result = CombinedScore.from(snapshot(scores));

        // (8x.30 + 7x.20 + 6x.15) / (.30 + .20 + .15) = 4.70 / 0.65
        assertThat(result.value()).isEqualByComparingTo("7.23");
        assertThat(result.level()).isEqualTo(SignalLevel.BUY);
        assertThat(result.usedSources()).containsExactlyInAnyOrder(
                SignalSource.TECHNICAL, SignalSource.NEWS, SignalSource.ANALYST);
    }

    @Test
    void aMissingSourceDoesNotDragTheScoreDownTheWayAZeroWould() {
        Map<SignalSource, BigDecimal> onlyTechnical = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        onlyTechnical.put(SignalSource.TECHNICAL, new BigDecimal("9"));

        CombinedScore result = CombinedScore.from(snapshot(onlyTechnical));

        assertThat(result.value()).isEqualByComparingTo("9.00");
        assertThat(result.level()).isEqualTo(SignalLevel.STRONG_BUY);
    }

    @Test
    void withNoSourcesAtAllTheScoreIsNeutralAndNoSourceIsClaimed() {
        CombinedScore result = CombinedScore.from(snapshot(Map.of()));

        assertThat(result.value()).isEqualByComparingTo("0.00");
        assertThat(result.level()).isEqualTo(SignalLevel.STRONG_SELL);
        assertThat(result.usedSources()).isEmpty();
    }

    @Test
    void ignoresSourcesReportedExplicitlyAsNull() {
        Map<SignalSource, BigDecimal> withNulls = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        withNulls.put(SignalSource.TECHNICAL, new BigDecimal("9"));
        withNulls.put(SignalSource.INSIDER, null);

        CombinedScore result = CombinedScore.from(snapshot(withNulls));

        assertThat(result.usedSources()).containsExactly(SignalSource.TECHNICAL);
        assertThat(result.value()).isEqualByComparingTo("9.00");
    }
}
```

Note on the empty case: a score of zero maps to `STRONG_SELL` by the threshold table, which is why callers must check `usedSources().isEmpty()` before presenting a level. Task 10 relies on that and excludes such tickers from the dashboard averages.

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

/**
 * A source of trading signal, with the weight it carries in the combined score.
 *
 * <p>The weights sum to 1.00. When a source has no data its weight is redistributed across the
 * remaining sources rather than counted as zero — see {@link CombinedScore#from(SignalSnapshot)}.
 */
public enum SignalSource {

    TECHNICAL(new BigDecimal("0.30")),
    NEWS(new BigDecimal("0.20")),
    ANALYST(new BigDecimal("0.15")),
    INSIDER(new BigDecimal("0.15")),
    SOCIAL(new BigDecimal("0.10")),
    WSB(new BigDecimal("0.10"));

    private final BigDecimal weight;

    SignalSource(BigDecimal weight) {
        this.weight = weight;
    }

    public BigDecimal weight() {
        return weight;
    }
}
```

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

import java.math.BigDecimal;

/** The recommendation a combined score maps to. */
public enum SignalLevel {

    STRONG_BUY,
    BUY,
    HOLD,
    SELL,
    STRONG_SELL;

    private static final BigDecimal STRONG_BUY_FLOOR = new BigDecimal("8.0");
    private static final BigDecimal BUY_FLOOR = new BigDecimal("6.5");
    private static final BigDecimal HOLD_FLOOR = new BigDecimal("4.5");
    private static final BigDecimal SELL_FLOOR = new BigDecimal("3.0");

    /** Maps a score on the one to ten scale to its recommendation. */
    public static SignalLevel fromScore(BigDecimal score) {
        if (score.compareTo(STRONG_BUY_FLOOR) >= 0) {
            return STRONG_BUY;
        }
        if (score.compareTo(BUY_FLOOR) >= 0) {
            return BUY;
        }
        if (score.compareTo(HOLD_FLOOR) >= 0) {
            return HOLD;
        }
        if (score.compareTo(SELL_FLOOR) >= 0) {
            return SELL;
        }
        return STRONG_SELL;
    }
}
```

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * The per-source signal scores recorded for one instrument on one day.
 *
 * <p>A source with no data is simply absent. Null values handed to the builder are dropped, so an
 * absent source and a source the provider explicitly reported as null are treated identically.
 */
public final class SignalSnapshot {

    private final Ticker ticker;
    private final LocalDate snapshotDate;
    private final Map<SignalSource, BigDecimal> scores;

    private SignalSnapshot(Builder builder) {
        this.ticker = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.ticker, "ticker must not be null");
        this.snapshotDate = Objects.requireNonNull(builder.snapshotDate, "snapshotDate must not be null");
        Map<SignalSource, BigDecimal> copy = new EnumMap<>(SignalSource.class);
        if (builder.scores != null) {
            builder.scores.forEach((source, score) -> {
                if (source != null && score != null) {
                    copy.put(source, score);
                }
            });
        }
        this.scores = Collections.unmodifiableMap(copy);
    }

    public static Builder builder() {
        return new Builder();
    }

    public Ticker ticker() {
        return ticker;
    }

    public LocalDate snapshotDate() {
        return snapshotDate;
    }

    public Map<SignalSource, BigDecimal> scores() {
        return scores;
    }

    public Optional<BigDecimal> scoreOf(SignalSource source) {
        return Optional.ofNullable(scores.get(source));
    }

    public Set<SignalSource> availableSources() {
        return scores.keySet();
    }

    /** Fluent builder for {@link SignalSnapshot}, following the convention of {@code Transaction.Builder}. */
    public static final class Builder {

        private Ticker ticker;
        private LocalDate snapshotDate;
        private Map<SignalSource, BigDecimal> scores;

        private Builder() {
        }

        public Builder ticker(Ticker ticker) {
            this.ticker = ticker;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder snapshotDate(LocalDate snapshotDate) {
            this.snapshotDate = snapshotDate;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder scores(Map<SignalSource, BigDecimal> scores) {
            this.scores = scores;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder score(SignalSource source, BigDecimal score) {
            if (this.scores == null) {
                this.scores = new EnumMap<>(SignalSource.class);
            }
            this.scores.put(source, score);
            return this;
        }

        public SignalSnapshot build() {
            return new SignalSnapshot(this);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package co.com.david.inversiones.model;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * The single score a snapshot reduces to, on the one to ten scale.
 *
 * @param value       the weighted score, at scale two
 * @param level       the recommendation the value maps to
 * @param usedSources which sources actually contributed; a value built from two sources is a weaker
 *                    claim than the same value built from six, and callers should say so
 */
public record CombinedScore(BigDecimal value, SignalLevel level, Set<SignalSource> usedSources) {

    private static final int SCALE = 2;

    /**
     * Reduces a snapshot to one score, redistributing the weight of missing sources across the
     * available ones.
     *
     * <p>Treating a missing source as zero would turn "no data" into a sell signal, so the available
     * weights are renormalized to sum to one instead:
     * {@code sum(score x weight) / sum(weight)} over the available sources only.
     *
     * <p>With no sources at all the value is zero and {@code usedSources} is empty. Callers must
     * check for that before presenting the level, which would otherwise read as a strong sell.
     */
    public static CombinedScore from(SignalSnapshot snapshot) {
        BigDecimal weightedSum = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        BigDecimal weightTotal = BigDecimal.ZERO;

        for (SignalSource source : snapshot.availableSources()) {
            BigDecimal score = snapshot.scores().get(source);
            weightedSum = weightedSum.add(score.multiply(source.weight()));
            weightTotal = weightTotal.add(source.weight());
        }

        BigDecimal value = weightTotal.signum() == 0
                ? BigDecimal.ZERO.setScale(SCALE, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)
                : weightedSum.divide(weightTotal, SCALE, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);

        return new CombinedScore(value, SignalLevel.fromScore(value), Set.copyOf(snapshot.availableSources()));
    }
}
```

### Task 10: Signals dashboard and snapshot persistence

**Files:**
- Create: `model/TickerSignal.java`, `model/SignalsDashboard.java`, `model/gateways/SignalProvider.java`, `model/gateways/SignalSnapshotRepository.java`
- Create: `usecase/signal/GetSignalsDashboardUseCase.java`, `usecase/signal/RefreshSignalSnapshotUseCase.java`
- Test: `usecase/signal/GetSignalsDashboardUseCaseTest.java`, `usecase/signal/RefreshSignalSnapshotUseCaseTest.java`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `SignalSnapshot`, `CombinedScore`, `Ticker`, `TransactionRepository`, `TimeProvider` (Tasks 6, 9).
- Produces:
  - `SignalProvider` port: `List<SignalSnapshot> fetchSnapshots(Set<Ticker> tickers, LocalDate date)` — returns one snapshot per ticker it could gather any data for.
  - `SignalSnapshotRepository` port: `SignalSnapshot save(SignalSnapshot)`, `List<SignalSnapshot> saveAll(List<SignalSnapshot>)`, `Optional<SignalSnapshot> findLatest(Ticker)`, `List<SignalSnapshot> findBetween(Ticker ticker, LocalDate from, LocalDate to)`.
  - `TickerSignal` record `(Ticker ticker, SignalSnapshot snapshot, CombinedScore score)`.
  - `SignalsDashboard` — builder over `List<TickerSignal> signals`, `BigDecimal averageScore`, `Map<SignalLevel, Integer> levelCounts`, `List<Ticker> tickersWithoutData`.
  - `GetSignalsDashboardUseCase.execute() -> SignalsDashboard` and `RefreshSignalSnapshotUseCase.execute() -> int` returning how many snapshots were stored.

**The rules being encoded.** The dashboard reads the latest persisted snapshot per held ticker, sorted by combined score descending — highest conviction first, which is the order the current dashboard sorts by. A ticker whose snapshot has no sources at all is **excluded from `averageScore` and `levelCounts`** and listed in `tickersWithoutData`, because a zero-source score maps to `STRONG_SELL` and would otherwise pull the average down and fabricate a sell recommendation. The refresh use case pulls from n8n through `SignalProvider` for every held ticker and persists what came back; a provider returning nothing stores nothing and reports zero rather than erasing yesterday's data.
